text:
Alex M: Heads-up — incident affecting EU inference region. Need marketing support on customer-facing cadence and status page copy. Webinar this afternoon; want comms plan for attendees and inbound leads. @Marta @Priya

Sam (oncall): We're throttling capacity for EU model pools. Root cause being investigated, ETA unknown. Current plan: failover to US for low-priority traffic, preserve reserved capacity. Will update in 15.

Marta (growth): Thanks. For the webinar: do we postpone or proceed? Attendee experience could be degraded. Suggest postponing to tomorrow noon unless resolves in 30m. Thoughts?

Priya (support): We're seeing elevated tickets from enterprise tenants — 12 active, with two P1s. I'll tag affected accounts and start targeted emails if we decide to postpone.

Jamie (product): Decision: postpone. If fix not in 20m, send postponement email with apology + reschedule link. Also route any inbound leads from webinar signup page to CS for SLA customers.

Marta (growth): Agreed. Draft of the email/statuspage copy below. Short, empathetic, don't promise ETA. Use single status page update now + follow-up when we have root cause.

Alex M: Proposed status page update (post immediately):
```text
We are investigating reduced serving capacity for the EU inference region affecting some customers' latency and streaming sessions. We are routing low-priority requests to other regions and working to restore full capacity. No action required from customers at this time. We will post another update within 30 minutes.
```

Marta (growth): Proposed webinar attendee message (send now if postponing):
```text
Hi — due to a regional service degradation, today's webinar will be postponed to tomorrow at 12:00 PDT. We're sorry for the inconvenience. A new invite will follow shortly. If you're experiencing production impact, reply and our team will prioritize your request.
```

Priya (support): For inbound leads routing: I'll create tag "incident-webinar" on affected signups and escalate any enterprise leads to the Oncall CS rep. Also recommend a short FAQ snippet for status page: 'Are my models or data impacted?' Answer: 'Model outputs remain intact; some latency/streaming interruptions may occur.'

Sam (oncall): Update — we've identified a memory leak in the shard manager, patch rolling now, expected partial restoration in ~18m. Will confirm once all shards report healthy.

Marta (growth): OK. Action items:
- Alex: publish status page copy now (done?)
- Priya: draft webinar postponement email (send if patch >20m)
- Jamie: route webinar leads to CS queue and flag enterprise
- Sam: update thread when shards healthy

Alex M: Publishing now. I'll also coordinate a shorter social post for customers on LinkedIn pointing to status page. Tagging @Marta for approval.

incident-bot: [deploybot] Patch rollout started: 6/8 shards updated (3 pending)

Marta (growth): LGTM on the social copy. Keep comms cadence to minimize confusion: status now, 30-min follow-up, postmortem email in ~24h.

Priya (support): Noted. Creating support playbook and canned responses now.

Jamie (product): Thanks team. Let's reconvene here in 20.

Alex M: Thanks — will update when we have the 30-min follow-up. :thumbsup:
